articles.title: Mathura Shocker | Sleeping 1-Year-Old Kidnapped from Railway Station, Rescued from Rajasthan
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Mathura (UP) – A 1-year-old girl kidnapped from Mathura Railway Junction while her mother went to the toilet has been safely rescued. The accused, Satish, was nabbed from Dholpur (Rajasthan) within hours. CCTV footage had captured him lifting the sleeping child and fleeing by train.

body.html:
Mathura (UP) – A 1-year-old girl kidnapped from Mathura Railway Junction while her mother went to the toilet has been safely rescued.

The accused, Satish, was nabbed from Dholpur (Rajasthan) within hours. CCTV footage had captured him lifting the sleeping child and fleeing by train.

During interrogation, Satish revealed that his wife had suffered four stillbirths, and in desperation to have a child, he abducted the girl.

Thanks to Mathura Police’s swift action, the child was reunited with her family. The accused has been sent to jail.

articles.title: Hyderabad Horror | Man Kills 5-Month Pregnant Wife, Chops Body & Dumps Parts in Musi River
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Hyderabad – In a gruesome crime, a 27-year-old driver, Mahender Reddy, allegedly strangled his 21-year-old pregnant wife, Swathi, at their Boduppal residence on Saturday evening following frequent quarrels.

body.html:
Hyderabad – In a gruesome crime, a 27-year-old driver, Mahender Reddy, allegedly strangled his 21-year-old pregnant wife, Swathi, at their Boduppal residence on Saturday evening following frequent quarrels.

According to police, the accused dismembered her body with a hexa blade, packed the parts in plastic covers and dumped them in the Musi river at Prathapsingaram. The torso was found at the house.

Police said Mahender initially tried to mislead relatives by claiming his wife was missing, but later confessed. A case of murder and destruction of evidence has been registered under BNS.

NDRF and GHMC teams have launched a search for the missing body parts. The couple, married in January 2024, reportedly had a history of disputes, including a domestic violence case filed earlier by the victim.

articles.title: Tricity Scare | Jeep Swept Away in Chandigarh Floodwaters, Video Sparks Panic
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Chandigarh – A terrifying video has gone viral showing a modified off-road jeep being swept away in the strong current of the Jayanti Devi river near Rao drain on Sunday evening.

body.html:
Chandigarh – A terrifying video has gone viral showing a modified off-road jeep being swept away in the strong current of the Jayanti Devi river near Rao drain on Sunday evening. Eyewitnesses said locals tried to stop the driver, but he attempted to cross the flooded stretch and lost control. The vehicle was quickly dragged away by the water.

Fortunately, the occupants managed to save their lives. The incident created panic among onlookers, many of whom questioned why such dangerous spots are not barricaded by the administration.

Police have launched an investigation and issued an alert in nearby areas to trace the jeep. Mullapur SHO Amandeep Trikha confirmed the video is under verification.

articles.title: Gorakhpur: Couple fined ₹2500 for flouting traffic rules
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A video from Gorakhpur’s Nauka Vihar Road (Ramgarhtal PS area) has gone viral, showing a young woman sitting in reverse on a bike’s fuel tank while holding her partner as they rode through the city. The stunt-like act drew heavy criticism online for being unsafe and against traffic norms.

body.html:
A video from Gorakhpur’s Nauka Vihar Road (Ramgarhtal PS area) has gone viral, showing a young woman sitting in reverse on a bike’s fuel tank while holding her partner as they rode through the city.

The stunt-like act drew heavy criticism online for being unsafe and against traffic norms. After the clip surfaced on social media, Gorakhpur Police traced the duo and issued a fine of ₹2500 for violating traffic rules.

Authorities have also appealed to citizens to prioritize road safety over show-off stunts.

articles.title: Noida: Woman Set Ablaze by In-Laws Over Dowry, Sister Captures Horror on Video
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Greater Noida – A shocking dowry death has come to light from Dadri area, where Nikki (married in 2016 to Vipin of Rupbas) was allegedly beaten and set ablaze with petrol by her husband and mother-in-law.

body.html:
Greater Noida – A shocking dowry death has come to light from Dadri area, where Nikki (married in 2016 to Vipin of Rupbas) was allegedly beaten and set ablaze with petrol by her husband and mother-in-law.

The victim’s family alleges that Nikki was regularly harassed over dowry and subjected to domestic violence, with her husband addicted to alcohol. On the same day, Nikki’s sister was also married into the same house, to Vipin’s brother.

In a chilling turn, Nikki’s sister reportedly recorded the assault and burning on her phone, and the video has now surfaced.

Following the incident, the family staged a protest at the police station demanding justice. Police have registered a case, formed investigation teams, and assured strict action given the seriousness of the charges.
